name: audit-claude-setup
description: Review the latest Claude Code documentation, compare it against the current Claude Code configuration, and recommend specific improvements based on new or underused features. Run periodically (e.g. monthly) to catch new capabilities that could improve the workflow. TRIGGER when: user asks to audit, review, or check their Claude Code setup / config / skills / hooks / MCP servers / settings, or asks "what new Claude Code features should I be using". DO NOT TRIGGER for: Codex setup audits, app-code audits, or PR/local-change reviews (use review-pr or review-local).
